primitives.name: Email Verification Stamp Primitive
primitives.verbatim_quote: --### D-1 — Stamp `emailVerified` from Google's `email_verified` claim **STATUS: DONE.** Without it the settlement worker refuses every recipient (column was never written) — Elite email alerts could never deliver to anyone.
primitives.assumptions: The Google OAuth provider populates `email_verified` correctly and the system enforces strict equality.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If `google_email_verified ≠ true`, then `emailVerified` remains unset, blocking alert delivery.

layer2.mapping: The stamp operation mirrors the identity function on boolean values under strict validation.
layer2.telemetry: Test suite result: `lib/auth.test.ts` D-1 suite passes all 5 tests.

primitives.name: Push Opt-In Mount Primitive
primitives.verbatim_quote: ### D-2 — Mount the push opt-in (web-push channel was dark by construction) **STATUS: DONE.** `components/push/push-alert-opt-in.tsx` existed, fully specified, mounted nowhere — no session path could create a `push_subscriptions` row.
primitives.assumptions: The component requires VAPID keys to render and does not initialize without them.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Component renders only when VAPID keys are present; otherwise remains in dark state.

layer2.mapping: Mounting integrates UI layer with backend DB layer via session-based conditional rendering.
layer2.telemetry: Test coverage includes DB/API layer integration but lacks component-specific test file.
